faq.q: How big is the Silverdale Comprehensive Planning Area?
faq.a: 1,392 ha (3,440 ac) inside the City's urban growth boundary, bordered by Silverdale Creek to the east, Silvermere Lake to the west and the Fraser River and ALR lands to the south, per the City's SCPA Neighbourhood Planning Terms of Reference (Policy LAN.64(C), adopted February 18, 2020).

faq.q: How did Mission sell in September 2026?
faq.a: At board community level: 231 detached listings with 28 sold (median $814,000, $353/sq ft, 94% sale-to-list, 29 days on market) and 122 Condos & Townhomes listings with 10 sold (median $430,000, $368/sq ft, 95%, 61 days); the urban Mission sub-area recorded 23 of the 28 detached sales and all 10 attached sales. No plan-area figures exist in the permitted source (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: When were City of Mission property taxes due in 2026, and what is the penalty?
faq.a: Due Thursday, July 2, 2026, with a 10% penalty added to any current balances outstanding (including unclaimed home owner grants) on July 3, 2026; the City states it has no authority to waive or modify the penalty.
